title: Rotorua One-Day Tour: Glowworm Cave & Geyser
brief: Enjoy a full-day Rotorua adventure where breathtaking nature meets deep Māori culture. Visit glowworm caves, stroll through the Redwoods, and explore Te Puia to see kiwi birds, traditional crafts, and the impressive Pohutu Geyser.

children.text: ☆ Visit a magical glowworm cave with thousands of tiny lights illuminate the cavern
☆ Explore the majestic Redwoods Forest, featuring rare giant red trees and tranquil walking paths.
☆ Discover Te Puia, Rotorua’s center of Māori tradition and pride.
☆ Observe New Zealand’s iconic kiwi bird in a protected environment.
☆ Witness the powerful eruption of the Pohutu Geyser, one of Rotorua’s most famous geothermal attractions.
Embark on an unforgettable full-day tour through Rotorua’s most iconic natural wonders and cultural treasures.
This experience blends the magic of New Zealand’s landscapes with the depth of Māori heritage, offering a day filled with discovery, beauty, and inspiration.

Your journey begins with a visit to glowworm cave* - a purpose-built forest caves in Rotorua's Redwoods, carefully designed to replicate the natural environment where glowworms thrive. Marvel at thousands of tiny lights shimmer across the dome-like ceiling. The glowworms shine so closely overhead that it feels as though you’re drifting beneath a living galaxy. This peaceful, dreamlike setting is one of New Zealand’s most enchanting natural spectacles.

Next, step into the extraordinary Redwoods Forest, a rare grove of towering redwood giants that reach skyward with breathtaking presence. Walking along the quiet forest paths, you’ll be surrounded by the soothing scent of the trees and the crisp, refreshing air that fills the entire woodland. It’s a tranquil escape that feels worlds away—an ideal moment to slowdown, breathe deeply, and reconnect with nature.

In the afternoon, the tour takes you to Te Puia, a cultural and geothermal heart of Rotorua. Here, you’ll witness traditional Māori craftsmanship, including wood carving and weaving, practiced by artisans who carry forward generations of knowledge. You’ll also have the chance to observe New Zealand’s beloved national bird, the kiwi, in a protected environment. And no visit to Te Puia would be complete without experiencing the dramatic eruption of Pohutu Geyser, one of the Southern Hemisphere’s most powerful geysers—an unforgettable display of geothermal energy.

From mystical caves to towering forests, from living culture to natural wonders, this tour brings together the very best of Rotorua in a single, deeply rewarding day. It’s a perfect way to immerse yourself in the unique spirit and beauty of New Zealand.
*Please be advised that there is no boat ride, and the tour remains entirely in the Rotorua region.

title: Queenstown to Fox Glacier Day Tour
brief: Travel across the South Island on a full-day coach tour through amazing natural scenery.

children.text: This tour runs Mon, Tue, Thu, Sat only!
See the majestic Southern Alps, picturesque lakes and rivers and the wild beauty of the West Coast on this full-day sightseeing bus tour from Queenstown to Fox Glacier.

Step aboard your luxury sightseeing tour coach and begin your journey with breathtaking scenery of high mountain peaks and crystal-clear blue lakes. Along the way your driver guide will provide commentary on this unique region. Pass man-made Lake Dunstan outside Cromwell, beautiful Lake Wanaka and its neighbouring Lake Hawea, and take a morning tea break at Makarora, a small settlement at the foot of Mount Shrimpton, where the Otago and West Coast regions meet.

Entering Mount Aspiring National Park, we follow the historic route used by Māori as they travelled across the Southern Alps in search of pounamu (greenstone). Journey through the Haast Pass, the southernmost pass between the South Island's two coasts, enjoying views of native beech forest, waterfalls and glacier-fed rivers.

Arriving on the West Coast, we enter an awe-inspiring landscape of vast rainforests, crystal clear waterfalls and rugged mountain tops. As we wind our way along the rocky coastline, the formidable peaks, moody blue rivers and the powerful surf create the perfect escape. Here you will discover an isolated and tranquil part of New Zealand.

Your one-way tour concludes as we reach the small village of Fox Glacier, set against the lush green rainforest and your base for exploration of this fascinating natural phenomenon. The Fox Glacier is a moving river of ice approximately 13 kilometres (8.1 miles) long, enclosed by sheer rock walls and soaring mountain peaks. You can speak to your driver for details about guided tours of the glacier.

title: Franz Josef Glacier Heli Hike
brief: Our world-renowned Glacier Heli Hike is the NZ Must Do not to be missed.

children.text: My favourite thing about the glacier is how much it moves, each trip really is different because it is constantly changing. Keeps it interesting!

With the combination of an exhilarating helicopter ride, jaw-dropping scenery and a three hour hike through the most spectacular glacier features, it's no wonder our guests often label their Glacier Heli Hike as the highlight of their visit to Aotearoa (New Zealand).
Your journey starts at our glacier base in Franz Josef Village where our friendly team will check you in, get you kitted out with the essential gear and give you a pre-trip briefing.

From here, your guide will lead you a on a short walk through native forest to the heli pad and get you ready to board your helicopter. Adrenaline levels start to spike as you board your helicopter and our highly trained pilot then whisks you away over the jaw dropping landscape - an opportunity to take in the full panoramic majesty of Kā Roimata o Hine Hukatere nestled within the surrounding mountains.

Your pilot will land you high up on the glacier itself, where your guide will help you make the final preparations for your hike before you head off to explore the pristine features of this incredible icescape.

Our guides are highly skilled in the art of step cutting, which means we can find you both the safest and most spectacular route available on the glacier. Because the glacier is so fast moving, its features are constantly changing - you might find yourself sliding through a narrow crevasse or between towering walls of ice, crawling through blue ice tunnels, hanging out in ice caves, or witnessing the glacier calving. You can be sure that you're seeing the glacier in a unique state and no two trips are ever quite the same.

During your hike your guide will share with you the story of Kā Roimata o Hine Hukatere, their knowledge of the glacier and surrounding area and insight on why Franz Josef is so unique. You'll come away from your trip not only with a sense of awe at this majestic beauty, but a whole new understanding of why this precious landmark is so special.

Farming in the New Zealand high country is a way of life – and it’s one you can get up close to at Walter Peak.

Situated on picturesque Lake Whakatipu’s south-western shores, Walter Peak High Country Farm is an idyllic place to spend a relaxing few hours. The farm tour itself is a wonderful, interactive experience, with something to keep everyone entertained and happy.

You will be greeted by our rural host upon disembarking the TSS Earnslaw, who will take you to the amphitheatre, where you will watch the remarkable skill with which the farm dogs round up sheep from the paddocks.

children.text: Embark on a guided day hike from Te Anau to Key Summit along the famed Routeburn Track, one of New Zealand's Great Walks. This trip can be done year-round, but winter conditions with snow and cold temperatures should be expected from May to September.

is a lush green space where you can relax, stroll, or enjoy a picnic under the shade of century-old trees. Adorned with sculptures, fountains, and flowerbeds, it’s a peaceful retreat from the city buzz and an excellent spot to recharge.
